title: micromatch stack: rename the strictZeros option across braces and to-regex-range
prompt: packages/ holds a slice of the micromatch dependency tree (micromatch, picomatch, braces, fill-range, to-regex-range, is-number), resolved by plain Node with NODE_PATH=packages. The brace range compiler asks for strict handling of zero-padded numbers through an option called `strictZeros`, which to-regex-range turns into its older `relaxZeros` flag. Rename the `strictZeros` option to `keepZeros` in every package that sets, forwards or reads it, so that the whole chain micromatch -> braces -> fill-range -> to-regex-range uses the new name. `relaxZeros` stays. The old name must have no effect and no longer appear anywhere in packages/. Generated patterns must not change.
